title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1969-02-06
lineage: SBD > MC > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard recording of a smoking ’69 Dead show with Dark Star, The Other One>Cryptical, Eleven and Lovelight blazing.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as “super‑smoking” with extended jams on Dark Star, The Other One into Cryptical, scorching Eleven and a high‑energy Lovelight. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity (aside from the first few seconds), making the show very listenable despite occasional minor slip‑ups.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance and the sound quality across many reviews; weighted average of show (≈4.5) and recording (≈4.0) yields ~4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the sound is wonderful after a brief glitch in the opening Dew; overall clear, balanced mix with no major drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A fiery, jam‑heavy set with seamless transitions; the band kept high momentum throughout and even extended the show when Iron Butterfly backed out.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone praised as perfect and his stage banter highlighted; described as “rolling ‘em” and leading the crowd.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ/harmonica work on Lovelight noted as powerful (“blows the door off”).
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann (Billy) called “nuts on the drums”; drum work generally praised despite one reviewer calling a solo a joke.
